seed_replay.mvn_draw_seed_rule: SeedSequence([base_seed, formal_mode_id, scenario_seed_id, replicate_index, 78111]); same Z shared by Quasi and HAC28

covariances.quasi_pearson: phi_hat * inverse(X' diag(mu_hat) X); phi_hat = Pearson sum((y-mu)^2/mu)/(n-p), no floor
covariances.hac28: per-replicate fit_poisson_irls beta_covariance_last_hac from Bartlett HAC bandwidth 28
covariances.psd_rule: symmetric eigendecomposition; accept min_eigenvalue >= -1e-10*max(1,max_abs_eigenvalue); clip only tolerated negative eigenvalues to zero for factorization

intervals.normal_wald: fitted A_hat +/- approved normal critical value times sqrt(g' V g)
intervals.exact_nonlinear_mc: 5th/95th empirical percentiles of sum(exp(offset+X beta_draw))-sum(exp(offset+Xcf beta_draw))
intervals.invalid_covariance_or_interval: planned uncovered; no draws from materially indefinite covariance
